name: Pussyhugger Penetration
source:
A young guy with no experience or education isn’t exactly the most desirable candidate on the marriage market or the job market, for that matter. And yet our hero lands what he thinks is his dream job and becomes a salesman at a sex shop! On his very first day on the job, everything goes wrong: first, all his attempts to help four attractive female customers end in embarrassment, and then Earth is attacked by alien invaders! To survive, the hero and his companions in misfortune will have to turn an unassuming sex toy shop into a fortified refuge.
Use the girls’ unexpected talents, complete a variety of dangerous missions, study the omnipresent pussyhugger and devious titling, and perhaps you’ll manage not only to survive, but also to give the cosmic occupiers a fitting rebuff. And, of course, don’t forget to pay attention to the ladies in your world-saving squad: the spicy desires that brought them to the sex shop in the first place haven’t gone anywhere!
translation:
一个既没经验又没学历的年轻小伙，不论在婚恋市场还是求职市场上显然都算不上什么香饽饽。然而我们的男主角却如愿找到了一份自以为梦寐以求的美差——去一家情趣用品店当导购！谁知上班第一天就状况百出：先是他试图接待四位性感女顾客时接连出糗闹笑话，紧接着地球竟然遭到了外星侵略者的大举袭击！为了活命，男主角与四位同病相怜的美女不得不把这间不起眼的情趣玩具店改造成固若金汤的避难堡垒。
善用女孩们意想不到的过人本领，完成各式各样的危险任务，深入研究无处不在的“抱穴虫”与狡诈的“乳虫”——说不定你们不仅能活下来，还能给这帮宇宙侵略者迎头痛击！当然，也别忘了好好关照救世小队里的女士们：当初驱使她们走进情趣用品店的火辣欲望，可半点都没有消退呢！
